description: This file is a PHP source script for the Administration Diagnostic page in a SuiteCRM module. It manages access control, initializes variables, and renders a Smarty template for diagnostics in the admin panel.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class, used for rendering templates with assigned variables.

methods.name: getClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates the module title section with links.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Translates a given string key into the current language.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme registry instance.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the Smarty template context.
